tasks.deliverable: Versioned request/response contract for one observable behavior, including its error response
acceptance: Given the workload's success and error scenarios, the contract distinguishes both outcomes
The consumer contract can run and the current provider fails verification for the intended missing behavior

tasks.deliverable: Consumer handling for the contracted success and error responses
acceptance: One scenario fails against the old consumer for the intended behavioral reason
The real consumer produces and consumes the versioned contract without a browser journey
evidence: before/after screenshots when the workload's presentation changes

tasks.deliverable: Provider implementation of the contracted success and error responses
acceptance: Provider verification first fails for the intended missing behavior
The actual provider then verifies the consumer contract, including the error case and compatibility expectations
evidence: sanitized HAR or request/response capture when required by the workload

tasks.deliverable: Verification report for the exact joined consumer and provider heads
acceptance: The coordinator records an integration head containing both accepted dependency heads before dispatch
All workload scenarios and real provider/consumer contract checks pass at that integration head
Every applicable evidence artifact is associated with a requirement, head, command, and result

tasks.deliverable: Independent attempts to falsify the behavior, compatibility, and evidence claims
acceptance: The reviewer reads the frozen initial workload and inspects the exact joined heads independently
Each finding has a stable ID, affected requirement, severity, reproduction, and owning task
The report states the tested limits instead of treating missing evidence as approval
evidence: reviewed workload digest and input heads

tasks.deliverable: Disposition and bounded correction of findings assigned to the provider atom
acceptance: An exclusive writer fixes assigned findings or records an evidence-backed dismissal
A behavioral fix has an intended red reproduction followed by green provider contract verification
If no provider finding applies, the task records a no-change result instead of manufacturing code or a PR
Findings assigned to another atom become separate mitigation nodes with that atom's ownership
evidence: new provider head and affected evidence replacements

tasks.deliverable: Independent compliance decision against the frozen initial workload and all current branch inputs
acceptance: The final integration head includes the accepted consumer and mitigated provider heads
Every initial requirement and scenario maps to current applicable evidence or an explicit unsatisfied result
All required comments, findings, checks, dependency gates, and evidence freshness checks have an accountable disposition
